title: Critical Minerals: From Commodity Exposure To Industrial Capacity
summary: Follow annual commodity baselines, substitution and recycling constraints, federal and Canadian delivery programs, and named nickel, rare-earth, and pilot-processing trails without equating options, selections, or awards with production.
current_state_summary: The Published record now combines commodity data, GAO's substitution and recycling assessment, a DOE 19-project selection, named nickel and rare-earth financing, and Canadian delivery programs while preserving qualification and production gates.
current_state: USGS provides the annual baseline and a commodity-specific gallium supply structure tied to semiconductor uses.
USAspending records a named Talon Nickel award with obligations, outlays, performance dates, and non-federal funding.
The Department of War records an executed MP Materials loan for heavy rare-earth separation at Mountain Pass.
DOE's accelerator remains a funding opportunity, while Canada's 2026 plan remains a program and agreement pipeline.

GAO finds that substitution and recycling pathways differ by material and application; DOE's May 2026 announcement identifies 19 selected pilot-scale processing projects that still need award and delivery evidence.
None of the Published records yet establishes qualified output, sustained production, customer acceptance, or supply security.

dependency_stack.current_state: USGS records current mineral statistics and a gallium supply structure connected to compound-semiconductor uses.
dependency_stack.boundary: National import reliance does not prove shortage, disruption, price exposure, or facility-level inventory.

dependency_stack.current_state: DOE and Natural Resources Canada identify processing, infrastructure, geoscience, research, and partnership priorities.
dependency_stack.boundary: A strategy, funding opportunity, or planned agreement is not an award, permit, facility, production line, or measured output.

dependency_stack.current_state: Talon Nickel and MP Materials records name recipients, instruments, amounts, locations, and intended processing capabilities.
dependency_stack.boundary: Obligation, outlay, and loan execution do not prove construction, commissioning, qualified material, offtake, or sustained production.

dependency_stack.current_state: The named projects create project-level trails for permits, site work, equipment, feedstock, utilities, workforce, and commissioning.
dependency_stack.boundary: Those downstream stages remain incomplete in the current Published record.

dependency_stack.current_state: No current pathway record establishes domestic supply security, customer qualification, substitution success, or durable market share.
dependency_stack.boundary: Outcome claims require measured output, quality, cost, customer, trade, and operating evidence.

evidence_limits: The pathway does not translate a national commodity baseline into a shortage at a named fab, battery plant, defense program, or region.
Award and loan records can change through later transactions and do not establish completed facilities or technical success.
Program plans and funding opportunities do not identify every final recipient, location, permit, utility requirement, or delivery schedule.
The current record lacks comparable commodity-level refining, qualification, offtake, production, recycling, substitution, and price evidence.
next_records: Talon Nickel and MP Materials permits, engineering, site-work, equipment, feedstock, utility, construction, commissioning, qualification, customer, and production records.
DOE accelerator selections, award instruments, recipients, locations, milestones, payments, test results, and commercialization records.
Canadian project-level contribution agreements, infrastructure contracts, permits, construction milestones, output measures, and recipient reporting.
Facility-level gallium procurement, inventory, qualification, supplier, price, substitution, recycling, and disruption records.
Comparable USGS, trade, producer, customer, and plant records for the commodities that most constrain chips, grids, batteries, and defense manufacturing.
